trigger: within the next 1..10 observed consecutive trading sessions, close > MA5 and breadth_score > previous_session_score
entry: next trading session index open, research price proxy
exit: holding-session20/60 index close, entry session included
missing_policy: cancel waiting state on missing breadth or observation gaps; never infer or backfill historical signals
scope: observational research only; no composite score or production buy/sell rule changes
